speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy findings of nuclear hyperchromasia and multinucleation are highly suggestive of a viral cytopathic effect, likely HPV-related. Given the presence of similar lesions on the finger (which could be a verruca vulgaris) and the penile shaft, I suspect this is a manifestation of HPV infection, potentially evolving into or mimicking squamous cell carcinoma. Do you have any other warts or skin changes elsewhere on your body, and have you noticed any itching or scaling around these specific lesions?
